newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM to convert 747 combis to full freighter.
newsitem.headline: KLM to convert 747 combis to full freighter.

text.p: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines will convert two combi aircraft into freighters, said a KLM spokesman.
The two Boeing 747-300 conversions, believed to cost in the region of U.S. $14m each, are expected to enter service during 1998, he added.
KLM now leases a B747-200 aircraft from U.S. carrier Atlas Air. This contract is expected to come up for renwal at the beginning of 1998.
The spokesman said that the two converted freighters do not necessarily mean that KLM will not renew the Atlas contract. "It depends on whether we need additional capacity at the time," he said.
Curently the airline is in negotiating with companies for the conversion work on the two aircraft but declined to identify them. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
